query:
SELECT 
  c.name,
  c.rarity,
  c.token_id,
  mps.avg_kills,
  mps.avg_balls,
  mps.avg_wart_distance,
  mps.win_rate,
  mps.match_count,
  ROUND(mps.avg_kills * 35 + mps.avg_balls * 10, 1) AS cage_match_bonus_per_match
FROM user_cards uc
JOIN champions c ON c.id = uc.champion_id
JOIN match_player_stats mps ON mps.champion_id = c.id
WHERE mps.match_count >= 10
ORDER BY cage_match_bonus_per_match DESC
LIMIT 20;
